messages:
ana: pushed a quick prototype for the trace action row. thinking about discoverability during incidents — export feels buried. https://redwood.test/figma/trace-actions-proto
leo: saw it. my gut: keep copy & open inline, move export into the top-level row (not in kebab). export is high signal for support and PMs.
sam: agreement. also mobile constraints: we only have room for 3 primary actions before it wraps. which 3 do we pick?
ana: proposed primary: [Copy correlation id] [Open trace] [Export]. secondary in kebab: pin, annotate, share.
jess: accessibility notes: 1) Kebab must have aria-label. 2) Action order must match tab order. 3) Provide a non-visual hint when export starts (aria-live) and when file is ready (link announced).
leo: implementation detail: export triggers async job. we'll show a toast with progress and include link. toast should be focusable for screen reader users.
sam: copy wording nits: use "Copy correlation ID" (full text) rather than "Copy ID". also for the open action use "Open trace in new tab" (explicit).
ana: short tooltip when hovered for first use: "Tip: press C to copy correlation id". but careful, tooltips are not accessible. make it an optional ephemeral banner that is also announced.
jess: keyboard shortcuts: C=copy, O=open, X=export (avoid E which conflicts with other shortcuts). add these to the keyboard help overlay. ensure shortcuts are announced in the help modal.
infra-bot: accessibility check: icon-only buttons need 44x44px hit target and 4.5:1 contrast on focus. current mock has 36px.
leo: thanks infra-bot, will update sizes. position-wise: should export be center or right-aligned? Right-aligned groups with other context actions (filter, timeframe).
sam: right-align makes sense visually, but grouping primary actions left keeps a consistent scan pattern. maybe left for copy/open/export then a spacer then metadata/actions.
jess: screen reader users often explore by landmarks. consider adding an aria-label on the action container: role="toolbar" aria-label="Trace actions". also ensure separators are semantically hidden.
ana: mobile behavior: long-press on copy should show "Copy full ID" vs "Copy with context". context copy includes trace URL + id. default copy should be raw id.
leo: file naming for exports: use "trace-<id>-<env>-<yyyyMMddHHmm>.zip" — makes support triage easier. include manifest.json inside zip with export options.
sam: small UX: after export completes show a pill action in the trace header: "Download export" that persists for 24h. easier than hunting in notifications.
jess: confirm live region phrasing: on start "Export started for trace <id>" and on completion "Export ready: press H to open downloads"? probably better: "Export ready. A download link is available in notifications." Keep short and descriptive.
ana: action items: ana to update mock with 44px targets and toolbar role; leo to align tab order and keyboard shortcuts; sam to mock the persistent download pill; jess to re-run a11y checklist after updates. I'll upload new frames by EOD.
leo: one more thought: show small inline status under export icon when job queued/processing (dot + label) so users know it didn't silently fail.
infra-bot: design review scheduled for Thursday. automated accessibility scan will run after PR is merged.
ana: thanks team — will iterate and post updated figma.
